from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();q=['Erdos problem 776 antichain n-3 distinct sizes r sets','Erdos problem 809 rainbow odd cycles F_k n squared 8','Erdos problem 944 vertex critical far edge criticality']

z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),str(p/'search-one.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(z.stdout);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr

 o=x['object']; relevant=[k for k in o if str(k) in ids]; relevant += [str(v) for k,v in o.items() if k in ['mathdb_id','id','problem_id'] and str(v) in ids]
 print('HISTORY',x['path'].split('/')[-2:],x['location'],'exactID',relevant,'source_scope',o.get('source_url',o.get('url','')))
